Floette was OHKOed by Kingambit’s Iron Head while attempting to pressure Dragonite, instantly handing the opponent a major advantage. From that point, the remaining 10% Dragapult and 1% Garchomp could not overcome a healthy Gengar and burned Kingambit, especially after consecutive Protect failures. reflections.adjustment: For Game 3, do not bring Floette if the opponent reveals a Steel-type like Kingambit. Instead, consider a Mega that resists or outruns Kingambit, or bring Garchomp with Earthquake to immediately threaten it. Focus on preserving Dragapult to spread burn onto physical attackers and maintain Tailwind support for speed control, while using Dragapult’s Ghost type to ignore Shadow Tag and pivot freely.
